## About This Site

This is the personal portfolio website of Madan Kumar PC, an educator, career counsellor,
and lifelong learner based in Tamil Nadu, India. The site is a static HTML/CSS/JS site
hosted on GitHub Pages. All content is factual and sourced from professional records.

---

## Who Is Madan Kumar PC?

Madan Kumar PC is a Cambridge Programme Coordinator, CAP Accredited Career Counsellor,
and EdTech advocate with over 15 years of professional experience spanning education
and information technology.

- Full name: Madan Kumar PC
- Location: Tamil Nadu, India
- Email: pcmadankumar@gmail.com

## Current Roles (as of October 2026)

The Indian Public School (TIPS) has four campuses in Tamil Nadu (Erode HQ, Salem, Trichy and a fourth campus).

1. Cambridge Implementation Coordinator — HQ
   Organisation: The Indian Public School (all four campuses)
   Since: February 2024
   Scope: Plans and executes Cambridge academic programme implementation across four campuses; advisory support to 5 Cambridge schools.

2. Exam Controller — Cambridge Examinations
   Organisation: The Indian Public School
   Since: 2018
   Scope: Runs the full Cambridge exam cycle; trains new Exams Officers and invigilators.

3. Future Pathways (FP) Coordinator — Career Guidance and Placement Support
   Organisation: The Indian Public School (all four campuses)
   Since: November 2020
   Scope: Leads the FP counselling team; 500+ students guided toward undergraduate decisions.

4. Professional Development Coordinator (PDC) — TIPS Learning and Research Institute
   Organisation: The Indian Public School
   Since: March 2024
   Scope: Part of the training team that delivers whole-school professional development to 400+ staff two to three
   times a year, helping every teacher reach a 50-hour annual training target. ISP Futures Framework training
   delivered 4 times to 250+ staff; CBSE-to-Cambridge induction 3 times, 50+ teachers each; AI for Educators in
   8+ cohorts of 20+ since 2024. See https://pcmadankumar.github.io/trainings.html

5. ISP Futures Coordinator
   Organisation: International Schools Partnership (ISP) / The Indian Public School
   Since: 2025
   Scope: Owns two of the five ISP Futures streams — Future Pathways and Life Competencies — across four campuses.

## Projects

Personal Portfolio Website — https://pcmadankumar.github.io
  A build-to-learn project; dark-themed, mobile-responsive static site deployed on GitHub Pages.
  Tech: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.

Dhruv 5.0 — locally hosted personal operating system with ten modules (Daily Anchor, Dashboard, Health, Notes & Journal,
  Calendar, Tasks, Goals, Finance, Leaves, Contacts).
  Tech: Electron, React, TypeScript, SQLite, Tesseract.js, Tailwind CSS.
  Demo available on request.

Markdown Viewer (Mark) — standalone Windows desktop Markdown viewer and exporter.
  Tech: Python, PyQt6, markdown2, Pygments, python-docx, PyInstaller.
  Demo available on request.

Invoice Tracker — multi-currency invoice management app for Cambridge Exam Coordinator workflows.
  Tech: React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQLite, Tailwind CSS, Chart.js.
  Demo available on request.

Cambridge Syllabus Management Toolkit — two-script Python toolkit for Cambridge programme coordination.
  Script 1 bulk-downloads all Cambridge IGCSE and AS & A Level syllabuses (155+ subjects) from the
  Cambridge International website, organised by qualification level and subject code.
  Script 2 reads each syllabus PDF, extracts exam series availability and administrative zone data,
  and generates a colour-coded Excel report with separate sheets for IGCSE and AS & A Level.
  Tech: Python, BeautifulSoup4, requests, pdfplumber, openpyxl.
  Demo available on request.

University & Course Admissions Advisory Series — fact-checked advisory documents on competitive university
  and entrance-exam pathways (ESAT, NATA/UCEED/NID, Materials Science abroad, Biotechnology in India,
  SAT vs IPMAT vs Cambridge A Level maths). Every claim verified against official university and board
  portals with numbered endnotes. Ships as branded Word, PDF, and an Excel exam/deadline matrix.

ISP University Virtual Tour Series — 12-part advisory series profiling QS Global Top 10 universities
  (MIT, Caltech, Yale, Princeton and others) across academics, admissions, and student life, plus an
  NUS/NTU admissions addendum. Used as a standing reference for Future Pathway counselling at TIPS.

Multilingualism Teacher Training Workshop — 75-slide professional development workshop on supporting
  multilingual learners; covers Learning Design theory, the CLIL framework, and classroom scaffolding.
  Includes a classroom case study, four activities, a strategy toolkit, and a reflection handout.
  Runs as a 3.5-hour session or two twilight sessions.

Safeguarding Teacher Training Presentation — professional development session on student safeguarding
  built to ISP compliance requirements, covering safeguarding responsibilities and reporting procedures.

CBSE to Cambridge Teacher Induction Programme — interactive 2-hour online induction for teachers moving
  from CBSE to the Cambridge curriculum; covers application-based pedagogy, assessment and command words,
  and curriculum planning, delivered with live polling. Being expanded into a self-paced induction series in Microsoft Teams.

Cambridge Exams Officer Training Modules — three-module training suite for new Cambridge Exams Officers,
  developed from the Cambridge Handbook 2026 and a 20-question scoping survey. Covers entries and fees,
  coursework moderation, secure storage and despatch, exam day, malpractice, results, and appeals through
  24 scenario exercises and a 70-question self-assessment quiz. Also produced as a centre-agnostic edition.

Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science Question Bank (0478) — topic-wise question bank built entirely from
  official past papers and mark schemes across all 10 syllabus topics, classified by learning outcome and
  difficulty band. 53 papers and nearly 4,000 marks, with knowledge organisers and a command-word guide.
  Shared with TIPS Computer Science teachers via SharePoint.

Cambridge AS & A Level Computer Science Question Bank (9618) — topic-wise bank from official 9618 past
  papers classified by learning objective and AS/A Level difficulty band, extended with knowledge organisers,
  a command-word guide, topic worksheets, and authored practice papers. Mid-build; Paper 4 (Python) pending.

English Practice Paper & Worksheet Library — original exam-style English materials for Cambridge Lower
  Secondary Stage 8 (22-paper series), IGCSE English as a Second Language, and AS Level General Paper
  comprehension. All passages original, mirroring Cambridge question taxonomy, mark allocation, and
  levels-of-response grids. Each paper ships with a full mark scheme, plus single-skill mini-worksheets.

Pragat — Evidence Portfolio — standalone Windows desktop application for professional evidence management.
  Collects, organises, and exports evidence of professional work mapped to four role-specific KPI frameworks.
  Supports file attachments, hyperlinks, rich notes, and multi-KPI linking. Generates formal PDF reports
  for leadership and a Markdown export for AI-assisted self-reflection on work quality.
  Tech: Electron, React, TypeScript, SQLite, electron-vite, pdfkit.
  Demo available on request.
